name: Cryptographic safeguards

subjectOf.text: Efficiency gains in PoS variants do not inherently compromise resilience, but only on the condition that the underlying cryptographic safeguards are robust.
subjectOf.abstract: Comparative analyses of PoS variants highlight that such efficiency gains do not inherently compromise resilience, provided cryptographic safeguards are robust, as they are in SPoS
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Cryptographic Foundations and Interdisciplinary Dimensions of the Secure Proof of Stake (SPoS) Conse (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5225296

subjectOf.text: AI self monitoring requires robust cryptographic safeguards and anti collusion algorithms; without them, agents overseeing one another can devolve into self serving behavior and coordinated manipulation.
subjectOf.abstract: and anti-collusion algorithms—to prevent coordinated manipulation or exploitation of vulnerabilities, ensuring that self-monitoring does not devolve into self-serving behavior.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How can we Best Monitor AI Agents (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5245185
scope_conditions: networks of interdependent agents auditing each other
